title: Search in a Rotated Sorted Array
summary: A sorted array of distinct numbers was rotated at an unknown point. Find a target's index in O(log n) time.

tests.explain: The sorted array [1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9] was rotated so that it starts at 5. The target 2 is at index 4.
A rotation by zero positions leaves the array fully sorted; that is allowed too.

hints: Cut the array at any mid. At least one of the two halves, [lo, mid] or [mid, hi], is still sorted in the normal way. Which one? Compare nums[lo] with nums[mid].
If the left half is sorted (nums[lo] <= nums[mid]), you can tell exactly whether the target lies inside it: nums[lo] <= target < nums[mid]. If so, search left; otherwise search right.
Same idea when the right half is sorted: check nums[mid] < target <= nums[hi]. Use a closed range (lo <= hi) and move lo = mid + 1 or hi = mid - 1.

complexity.time: O(log n): one half is discarded every step
